messages:
mira (pm): Quick sync: AstraCredit asked for a staged rollout of the new pricing guidance UI. Requirements: tenant-isolated flag, A/B test for conversion, per-tenant cost cap, and an emergency quiet-fallback path that returns to legacy inline suggestions. They also want exportable audit events for compliance.

lina (sales): AstraCredit legal wants explicit rollback SLAs and a named on-call for the first 48h. They'll require an opt-in toggle in their admin console.

tony (eng): Proposal: create feature flag `ui.pricing.guidance.v3` with three modes: off / control / experiment. For AstraCredit we set override->experiment at 10% then ramp. Also implement a cheap-render fallback `guidance.v3-lite` that uses cached embeddings to save tokens.

sam (sre): From infra side: need a tenant-level quota on token spend: policy `token_budget_per_hour` with soft and hard limits. If soft-limit breached -> reduce experiment exposure; if hard-limit breached -> auto-switch to `v3-lite` and tone down sampling. Monitoring: p95 latency, 5xx, token burn rate, and conversion delta.

mira (pm): Go/no-go gates after initial 2h window (4x30m buckets):
- conversion uplift >= +1.5% OR no negative delta > -0.5%
- token burn delta <= +12%
- p95 latency delta <= +200ms
If any gate fails -> immediate rollback to control and trigger postmortem.

lina (sales): Also ask AstraCredit if they'd accept a customer-visible "limited feature" banner during early ramp. That would ease rollback communications.

tony (eng): Implementation details: routing rule snippet for fast-fallback:
```yaml
routing:
  - match: tenant == "astracredit" && flag == "experiment"
    action: route_to: guidance_v3
    on_error: route_to: guidance_v3-lite
    cost_protect: true
```
This ensures we don't accidently send users to expensive paths after fallback.

sam (sre): Circuit-breaker thresholds to wire into the rollout engine:
- error_rate >= 0.4% for 3 consecutive 5m buckets
- token_burn_rate > budget * 1.3 for 2 buckets
- p95_latency > 1500ms for 3 buckets
Action: auto-toggle flag -> control, and push webhook to AstraCredit support channel.

mira (pm): Data collection plan: bucket events by cohort and tenant, export hourly CSV to the customer's S3 (they requested). Also capture the exact flag state in each event for audit. Lina, confirm S3 paths and KMS key names.

lina (sales): Confirmed. AstraCredit will use `arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:99999:key/abc-astracredit-01`. They want 48h of raw event retention visible to them.

tony (eng): Dev tasks: 1) flag + routing rule; 2) cheap-mode implementation + cached embeddings; 3) telemetry hook for flag_state and token_cost. I'll split into three PRs.

sam (sre): Ops tasks: 1) token budget enforcer; 2) circuit-breaker + alerts; 3) webhook to customer channel + incident playbook. I'll draft the playbook.

mira (pm): Acceptance criteria for release: feature flag in prod off-by-default, canary infra tested in staging, golden-run eval comparing control/experiment on a held-out prompt set, runbook with contact list, and legal sign-off on SLA language.

lina (sales): I'll coordinate the legal sign-off and schedule a pre-launch review with AstraCredit for 2026-05-10 16:00 UTC.

ops-bot: CI pipeline queued: `ui-guidance-v3/canary` -> smoke tests -> staging-run -> scheduled prod canary 2026-05-12 09:00 UTC

mira (pm): Timeline & owners: Tony (eng) feature PRs by 2026-05-03, Sam (sre) playbook + infra by 2026-05-05, Lina get legal & customer opt-in by 2026-05-08. I'll coordinate launch and close loop.

lina (sales): Question: Does the cheap-mode require a different model artifact or just quant settings? Tony?

tony (eng): Cheap-mode is quant+cache + smaller context window. No new model version required, just different runtime config. Should be quick.

sam (sre): One more ask: add a debug flag for internal sessions so we can shadow full model responses without billing customer. Useful for post-fallback analysis.

mira (pm): Good call. Add `trace.debug_shadow=true` for internal ops only.

lina (sales): :thumbsup: will relay to AstraCredit.

tony (eng): will open PRs today.

sam (sre): will draft playbook now and link here when ready.

mira (pm): Please react with :white_check_mark: when your item PR/link is added. Closing thread after owners ack.
